world.title: Amid overall drop, Indians still receive highest number of long-term UK visas among non-EU arrivals
world.summary: Indians remain the largest group receiving long-term work and student visas in the UK among non-EU nationals, despite a general decline in new arrivals. This trend persists even as emigration of Indian-origin individuals from Britain has increased. The data highlights the continued significance of Indian applicants in the UK visa system, reflecting ongoing demand for education and employment opportunities.

world.title: US-Iran war news LIVE: Trump wants Strait of Hormuz ‘without tolls’ after Iran proposed permanent system with Oman
world.summary: US President Donald Trump stated that the United States opposes tolls on the Strait of Hormuz. He also emphasized the intention to retrieve Iran's stockpile of highly enriched uranium. This statement comes amidst ongoing tensions between the US and Iran, particularly regarding Iran's nuclear capabilities and proposed agreements with Oman concerning the Strait's management.

world.title: India great partner, ready to expand energy cooperation: Rubio
world.summary: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced plans to enhance energy cooperation with India during his visit from May 23-26, 2026. He stated that discussions with Indian officials would focus on expanding energy partnerships. Rubio emphasized the importance of the U.S.-India relationship and expressed a desire to increase energy exports to India as part of these talks.

business.title: U.S. Awards $2 Billion to Nine Quantum Computing Companies
business.summary: The Trump administration is awarding $2 billion in CHIPS Act grants to nine quantum computing companies, including IBM, which will receive $1 billion. The government will take equity stakes in all awarded companies. Other recipients include IonQ, D-Wave Quantum, and Rigetti Computing. Following the announcement, these companies experienced significant stock surges in New York premarket trading.

business.title: Maruti share price in focus as automaker announces price hike of up to ₹30,000 from June ‘26
business.summary: Maruti Suzuki India announced a price hike of up to ₹30,000 for its vehicle models, effective June 2026. The automaker cited inflationary pressures and a challenging cost environment as reasons for the increase. The specific amount will vary by model, according to a regulatory filing. This decision reflects the company's response to current economic conditions affecting production costs.

business.title: Petrol pumps running dry in India? Not us, say Indian Oil, BPCL and HPCL
business.summary: Indian Oil, BPCL, and HPCL have denied reports of fuel rationing amid dry-outs at petrol pumps across India, from Punjab to Odisha. They attribute the situation to increased demand from the harvest season and a shift in consumer preference from private retailers. Indian Oil confirmed that fuel supplies remain stable and no rationing instructions have been issued.

technology.title: Bungie Walks Away From Destiny 2, Final Content Update Coming in June
technology.summary: Bungie has announced it will cease content updates for Destiny 2, concluding nearly nine years of support for the live service shooter. The final content update, titled "The Final Shape," is scheduled for release in June. Bungie, known for its work on the Halo franchise, has recently shifted focus to its new extraction shooter, Marathon.

technology.title: Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate - Deathwatch Announced at Warhammer Skulls 2026
technology.summary: Warhammer Skulls 2026 announced the sequel to the strategy game Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate – Daemonhunters, titled Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate – Deathwatch. Developed by Complex Games, the new installment focuses on the Deathwatch, a specialized unit within the Warhammer 40,000 universe. Further details about gameplay and release dates were not disclosed during the announcement.

technology.title: Smart-home vendors raise prices with AI subscriptions
technology.summary: Google is expanding its AI-powered Gemini for Home capabilities to allow third-party manufacturers to integrate Gemini features into their products. Ravi Akella, director of product management, stated this will enable service providers and hardware manufacturers to create monetizable, proactive services for users. This shift is seen as an industry trend towards AI as a business model, increasing costs for consumers.

sports.title: Will MS Dhoni play in IPL 2027? CSK captain Ruturaj Gaikwad gives 'next year' update
sports.summary: MS Dhoni's participation in IPL 2027 remains uncertain, as he did not play in IPL 2026. Chennai Super Kings captain Ruturaj Gaikwad addressed the speculation surrounding Dhoni's future following the team's significant 89-run defeat. The franchise and fans are awaiting updates on whether the legendary cricketer will return for the next season of the tournament.

sports.title: Painted Red and Gold: East Bengal won maiden ISL title
sports.summary: East Bengal won their first Indian Super League title by defeating Inter Kashi 2-1 in the final held on May 21, 2026. This victory marked the end of a 22-year wait for a national league triumph. Goals from Youssef Ezzejjari and Mohammed Rashid secured the win, bringing joy to fans at the Kishore Bharati Krirangan in Kolkata.

sports.title: IPL Playoffs Scenario: 4 Teams, 1 Spot - What CSK's Loss Means For RR, PBKS, KKR And DC
sports.summary: Chennai Super Kings' recent 89-run loss to Gujarat Titans has left one playoff spot open in the IPL 2026, with four teams vying for it: Rajasthan Royals, Punjab Kings, Kolkata Knight Riders, and Delhi Capitals. CSK concluded their season with 12 points from 14 matches, while three playoff spots have already been secured by other teams.

health.title: Childhood junk food can rewire brain for life: Study
health.summary: A study indicates that consuming large amounts of junk food during childhood can lead to permanent changes in the brain, affecting appetite control. Researchers found that diets high in fat and sugar can alter eating habits, which may persist even if an individual later switches to a healthier diet. These findings highlight the long-term impact of early dietary choices.

health.title: Australia unveils major package to tackle serious diphtheria outbreak
health.summary: The Australian government announced a 7.2-million-Australian-dollar package to address a significant diphtheria outbreak, the largest since record-keeping began. Health Minister Mark Butler stated that the National Notifiable Disease Surveillance System has reported 230 diphtheria cases this year, with approximately 60 percent of those cases occurring in unvaccinated individuals. The funding aims to enhance public health responses and vaccination efforts.

health.title: Gavi statement on the Ebola disease outbreak in Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda
health.summary: Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance, is monitoring the Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus affecting the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, while the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention has labeled it a Public Health Emergency of Continental Security.

science.title: New artificial intelligence model maps how genes work together inside cells
science.summary: Scientists at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai have developed a new artificial intelligence model that elucidates how genes interact within human cells. This innovative approach provides insights into gene functionality, enhancing the understanding of biological processes and diseases. The model represents a significant advancement in the field of genetics and could inform future research and therapeutic strategies.

science.title: Scientists Discover New Fuel-Saving Route to the Moon
science.summary: Researchers have identified a new low-fuel trajectory to the Moon, potentially lowering mission costs and enhancing spacecraft communication. This route utilizes hidden gravitational pathways in space, which could significantly reduce the amount of propellant required for lunar travel. The discovery aims to alleviate the financial and logistical burdens associated with traditional Moon missions, improving overall efficiency.

science.title: Crystals of space and time: A structural phenomenon that may collapse into tiny black holes
science.summary: A research team from Vienna and Frankfurt has discovered a formula indicating that space and time can create a "crystal" structure, which may potentially collapse into tiny black holes. This phenomenon is detailed in the journal Physical Review Letters. The findings contribute to the understanding of the fundamental nature of space-time and its possible implications in theoretical physics.

entertainment.title: Peddi item song: Hookline for Ram Charan and Shruti Haasan’s track revealed
entertainment.summary: The special item song "Hellallallo" from Ram Charan's film Peddi will be revealed on May 23 during a grand event in Bhopal. Preparations for the promotional event are in progress, featuring a live performance by AR Rahman. The song is part of the latest Telugu cinema updates, alongside news on movie reviews, box office collections, and OTT releases.

entertainment.title: Mohanlal Drishyam 3 Malayalam Movie Review, Box Office Collection Update
entertainment.summary: Mohanlal's film Drishyam 3 premiered on May 21, coinciding with the actor's 66th birthday. The movie, directed by Jeethu Joseph, features Mohanlal reprising his role as Georgekutty. It is projected to gross over Rs 50 crore worldwide on its opening day. As of now, the film has already collected Rs 35 crore at the box office.
